facts.summary: Phase 3 missed primary PFS endpoint, no difference vs paclitaxel · Phase 3 · batiraxcept in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The AXLerate trial evaluating the safety and efficacy of batiraxcept in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer did not meet its primary endpoint of progression-free survival (“PFS”) in the pre-specified subset of patients naïve to prior bevacizumab treatment.
